summary: Historical Docker/Wine technical feasibility and the exact RDP-era Octane contract remain qualified 10/10. The browser transport now has attributable evidence: run 0e2276a168 authenticated, negotiated noVNC, and delivered the intended XFCE framebuffer in the ChatGPT in-app browser with no RDP path. The installed application did not remain usable: its host exited after WebView2 HRESULT 0x800700AA. A new 90-second sustained-readiness gate then rejected standalone-Xorg run e1e95b2d01 and TigerVNC-Xvnc run 7d9e41587c when CrBrowserMain became defunct after the same Wine virtual_setup_exception stack-overflow signature while the native frame stayed white. Workload, browser-originated input, dialogs, export, and the browser 10/10 batch remain blocked or not run. The appliance/browser runtime kit is therefore an accurately measured diagnostic candidate, not a qualified browser release.
